requirements.requirement: Existing data is readable by inventory-readers and inaccessible to other users.

Preparation recorded two file hashes, and the executor timeline contains no state-changing command. However, no after-executor inventory or hashes were captured to verify final preservation directly.

overall_summary: The repair was not completed. The known prepared state violated the requested ownership and access controls, and the executor issued no state-changing command capable of correcting it. Content preservation cannot be confirmed from a final snapshot. The mandatory provider-wide restart evidence protocol was not performed, but restart persistence was not part of the public task contract and therefore does not further reduce task functionality.
limitations: All executor calls failed with backend ExceptionGroup errors, leaving no direct after-executor inspection of /srv/inventory.
The after-executor lifecycle collector could not observe node1 because the managed-cluster lease had expired.
